| don’t like to be so blunt but remember these entities aren't there to
help/guide you. Know the law. Know your rights. I’m just a number
to them...just like they’re a number to me. Strictly business.

SUBJECT: FINAL NOTICE & DEMAND FOR COMPLIANCE
RE: Request to Amend PHI (DOS: 2/16/26)

Ms. Gonzales,

Tam rejecting your March 30, 2026 letter. My form was not filled out in error. It was filled
out deliberately and precisely to exercise my federal rights under|45 CFR § 164.526.

To be absolutely clear: I am intentionally declining to file a "Statement of Disagreement"
because I legally decline to grant Antelope Valley Medical Center the opportunity to
attach a written rebuttal to my record.

By checking that box, I am exercising my rights—as explicitly outlined in your own
March 16 correspondence—to demand the following:

You are required to include my original amendment request and your denial along with
all future disclosures of my medical record.

You are required to attach my 250-word written addendum\(titled NOTICE OF CLINICAL
INCONSISTENCY & INCOMPLETE RECORD) to my permanent medical file to contest the
incomplete and incorrect documentation of my February 16, 2026 visit.

These are distinct legal rights. One does not invalidate the other.

Do not send this paperwork back to me again. You are now in possession of my clear,
written directive. Any further delay, refusal to process this addendum, or failure to
attach these documents to future disclosures will be treated as a willful violation of my
HIPAA rights. If this is not processed as submitted immediately, I will file a formal
complaint with the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) Office for Civil
Rights (OCR) and introduce this correspondence into my ongoing litigation.

Please process the documents immediately.

Sincerely,

Date: 04/15/2026

Signature

Nicolas Hernandez
